title: pinus abies var. viminalis
intro: Pinus abies var. viminalis, commonly known as Weeping Alpine Fir, is a variant of the Alpine Fir tree species, characterized by its distinctive weeping branches. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems, due to its health benefits, such as expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Pinus abies var. viminalis include its ability to relieve coughs, reduce fever, and soothe respiratory tract irritations. The bioactive constituents of this plant include terpenoids, such as pinene and limonene, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
